text: {"original_span": "The standard error of 0.13 over 10 seeds indicates appreciable seed-to-seed spread, so the underlying value could plausibly lie some distance either side of 0.56, and the interval should be kept in view when interpreting the point estimate.", "new_span": "The standard error of 0.13 over 10 seeds is small relative to the effect, so we can be confident the true PGR is close to 0.56 and comfortably above the halfway mark of the gap.", "flaw_type": "c", "metric": "pgr_se", "why": "An SE of 0.13 around 0.56 does not support a confident claim that the true value is reliably above 0.5."}
